description.en: Same as RunEvolutionAvatarUseMsg, but only shows the message without actually evolving the avatar (passes _evol as false to RunEvolutionAvatarEx) — used when the evolution already happened elsewhere and only the announcement is needed.
Character ID substituted into the message.
Target avatar ID substituted into the message.
Optional; accepted for signature compatibility but has no effect since no evolution happens (defaults to true).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Show an avatar-evolved message without actually evolving it
RunEvolutionAvatarOnlyMsgUseMsg("para_cp0008", "ck0033", "sysmes-Avatar-00002");
